name: jev-chess-arena
description: Arena de xadrez para comparar decisões de modelos: demo no navegador, provedores reais no servidor local.

scripts.demo: node scripts/with-env.mjs VITE_ARENA_MODE=demo -- npm run dev -w web
scripts.build:demo: node scripts/with-env.mjs VITE_ARENA_MODE=demo -- npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core -w server -w web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:secrets && npm run build:demo
